CMS increased CCM reimbursement by 8-11% across all codes, the largest bump in five years
.

## Payment Rates for 2026


Medicare pays between $43.76 and $144.29 per patient per month for Chronic Care Management (CCM) under the 2026 fee schedule, depending on code selection and practice setting
. 
A single Medicare patient receiving non-complex CCM can generate approximately $66 to $166 per month depending on time invested, with complex CCM generating up to $222 or more per month
.

## CCM CPT Codes for 2026


Seven CPT codes make up the CCM billing framework for 2026, spanning non-complex staff-directed care (99490, 99439), physician-driven care (99491, 99437), and complex care management (99487, 99489)
.

## Patient Cost-Sharing


The 2026 Medicare Part B deductible is $283. Once patients meet this annual deductible, they are typically responsible for a 20% coinsurance for CCM services. This usually results in an out-of-pocket cost of $7 to $10 per month
.

## Concurrent Billing


CCM can be billed concurrently with RPM and BHI when documentation and time requirements are met independently, creating layered revenue of approximately $200 to $300+ per patient per month
.
